shortDescription.text: golang.org/x/net v0.55.0 is affected by GO-2026-6603 (CVE-2026-78659) (no severity rating)

fullDescription.text: OSV.dev reports GO-2026-6603 (CVE-2026-78659) for Go package golang.org/x/net at version v0.55.0: HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to Trailer headers in net/http. The advisory carries neither a CVSS vector nor a database severity, so QSI rates it low and preliminary until it is triaged. govulncheck traced a call from the product code to the affected code: module.main → … → golang.org/x/net/http2.SettingID.String. Triage the advisory; upgrade to a fixed version (0.60.0) if it applies. Advisory data comes from OSV.dev at the recorded time. The advisory has no severity rating. Reachability was decided by govulncheck@v1.9.0 with the Go vulnerability database of 2026-11-23: a call graph from the product's packages (tests, examples and benchmarks left out) through every dependency to the affected functions. Calls through reflection, unsafe pointers or assembly are not followed.
